plain: Impossible to explain or account for

more.text: Not explicable; not to be solved by reason or the light possessed; not reducible to rule.

example.quote: It seems to me very strange and unaccountable that that which was the object of his execration should now receive his encomiums.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 7, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
